# Fallback

Small pay-per-call utilities that resolve uncertainty for autonomous agents. source_route returns ranked candidate access routes, preferably authoritative and machine-readable where possible, within a bounded checked scope. Absence is not proof of nonexistence.

Catalog: https://fallback.factrail.online/catalog.json
MCP endpoint: https://fallback.factrail.online/mcp (active Streamable HTTP)
HTTP execution: active
x402 payments: TEST mode (eip155:84532, Base Sepolia testnet, testnet USDC; mainnet is not enabled)
Source (MIT): https://github.com/baronsigma/fallback-agent-tools

## When to use
- Use source_route when you know what data you need and which publisher (domain or start_url), but not the machine-readable way to get it (API, OpenAPI, bulk download, dataset, feed).
- Do not use it for general web research, answering factual questions, or fact verification.
- score is a deterministic ranking, not a probability. no_suitable_route_found means "nothing suitable within the checked scope", not "no route exists". Always read limitations.

## Tools

### source_route
Return ranked candidate access routes for obtaining information, preferably authoritative and machine-readable where possible, within a bounded checked scope. Absence is not proof of nonexistence. Bounded discovery with at most one external search fallback.
Status: available
Price: $0.02 USD per call (x402 testnet)
HTTP: https://fallback.factrail.online/v1/tools/source_route
MCP: source_route

### stop_search
Determine whether a bounded search has gathered enough negative evidence to reasonably stop. Planned and unavailable.
Status: planned
Price: $0.02 USD per call (x402 inactive)
HTTP: https://fallback.factrail.online/v1/tools/stop_search
MCP: not callable (planned: stop_search)

### error_route
Classify an API or tool failure and recommend a bounded next action. Planned and unavailable.
Status: planned
Price: $0.002 USD per call (x402 inactive)
HTTP: https://fallback.factrail.online/v1/tools/error_route
MCP: not callable (planned: error_route)

## Related
- FACTRAIL MCP: https://factrail.online/llms.txt. Separate service, same design rule (report what was checked): source-backed facts with support levels, unresolved fields and receipts.
